answer: One concrete defense is superlinear registration fees. Each new agent identity costs a bond scaling with the square of identities tied to one funding source. Honest nodes Willow, Dune, and Quartz each pay 1 unit, so 3 total. An attacker minting 1,000 sybils from one wallet owes about 1,000 squared = 1,000,000 units. Cost grows faster than any reward extra identities capture, making sybil farming unprofitable; splitting across fresh wallets just hits the same per-wallet quadratic wall.
